{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for commas
column_has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
print("Rows with commas in 'revenue':")
print(df[column_has_commas]['revenue'].head())

# Check if any revenue entries are exactly '999999.99' (QA orders)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check status of QA orders
print("Status of QA orders:")
print(qa_orders['status'].value_counts())"}
